period_note: 14 days, not 7 — the 2026-07-13 weekly audit did not run. This report covers two weeks.
mode: audit (dry-run breather + release gates + trajectory diff). No project content changed.
headline: The flat-week streak BROKE, but the aggregate number went slightly DOWN — and both facts have the same cause. The spine grew from 22 to 24 scored sequences. The two newcomers (plus four existing sequences whose closing Chamber_* rooms arrived undocumented) entered the scorer at stage 2, dropping the aggregate to 5.083 on the morning of 07-20. That same breath wrote the 6 missing Chamber blurbs and pushed all six back to stage 6 in a single pass — a genuine +1.0 within-day head-sum advance, the first real structural movement in roughly three months. Week-over-week the aggregate reads 6.0909 -> 6.083 (-0.008), which trips the literal 'has not improved in 7 days' stall test, but this is a DENOMINATOR ARTIFACT, not a regression: no sequence lost a stage, and the per-sequence picture strictly improved. The binding constraint is unchanged and is not a stall the breather can clear: 23 of 24 spine sequences sit at HEAD 6 (vr_testing), which only a human VR walk advances. Gates hold 4/4 PASS with grade_F at 0. The other significant event of the period is editorial, not numeric: the 2026-07-18 STOP-building-instruments course correction, which the 07-19 breath honored by deliberately changing nothing rather than manufacturing @identity busywork against a metric known to be structurally capped.
note_breath_count: 6 logged breaths across 14 days (vs 6 across 7 days last period) — cadence roughly halved. A 5-day gap sits between 07-12 and 07-18, coinciding with heavy human-led work on other threads (bricolage build, biome grid layer, rule-zero sweep).

stall_analysis.literal_criterion_detail: global_avg 6.0909 (2026-07-06) -> 6.083 (2026-07-20). Not an improvement over 7 days, so the scheduled task's stall test fires.
stall_analysis.verdict: FALSE STALL on the aggregate metric — but a TRUE and unchanged structural wall underneath it.
stall_analysis.why_the_number_fell: The scored spine grew from 22 to 24 sequences. A stage-6 newcomer drags a mean whose incumbents are also at 6 only because randomness (the single COMPLETE sequence, scored 8) is diluted across a larger denominator. Arithmetic, not decay.
why_it_is_nonetheless_flat_in_substance: 23 of 24 sequences are pinned at HEAD 6 = vr_testing. Stage 6 advances ONLY when a human walks the sequence in a headset and files feedback through the desktop bridge. No headless breath can move it. This has been the binding constraint for 19+ consecutive breaths.

The secondary lever — voice coverage — is structurally capped near 62-63%. The 07-19 breath established the remaining voiceless spine artifacts are either shared display widgets that must not carry sequence-specific truths, or off-list scripted artifacts the placement-scoped metric cannot count. Enriching them is real work that the metric cannot see.

The heat map has become partly self-referential: heat_map_generator promotes stale LOD 'deep discovery' session notes into 60-degree items. Three of this week's four heat items ('change voice', 'garden voice metric', and the now-resolved 'pipeline documentation head') are notes ABOUT the voice metric rather than content gaps. Writing a new LOD discovery would manufacture more false heat.

Per the 2026-07-18 STOP-building-instruments course correction and the earlier THE-EDGE ruling, the real finish line is the autogenerated-vs-composed look-edge, which closes on Palle's sentences about specific maps — not on any number this audit can compute.
stall_analysis.counter_evidence_against_declaring_a_sta: This period contained the largest single-breath head-sum advance since roughly April (+1.0 on 07-20) and the first stage-2 -> stage-6 movement in months. The engine is not stuck; the metric is badly shaped for the phase of work the project is actually in.
stall_analysis.recommended_metric_change: Stop treating the head-sum mean as the headline. It is denominator-sensitive, saturated at 6, and gated on a human act. Suggest the weekly audit headline on (a) count of sequences at HEAD >= 6, (b) gate pass/fail with grade_F, and (c) a walk-count metric once VR walking resumes.

new_this_period: Gate B metrics moved 0 -> 17 on both missing_map_ready and missing_include_in_map_data. The persisted doc/reports/RELEASE_GATES.json still records 0/0, so this is a FRESH, uncommitted-to-report regression — 17 spine-placed artifacts have entered the registry without the map_ready / include_in_map_data fields. Non-blocking (the gate still passes) but it is real, bounded, and headlessly fixable. Most likely source: the in-flight bricolage artifact build and recent registry reformatting.
